shared_elements: schematic low-relief/outline symbols carved on stone
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic carved signs including a ring or disc and curved crescent-shaped strokes, which is about as generic as shared iconography gets. A depicts a single monumental anthropomorphic figure with head, torso and belt-like bands whose symbols are organised on the body, while B is a flat rock surface scattered with many small independent motifs (boat-like curved lines, framed rectangles, rows of marks) with no figural body organising them.
